title: 3755. Find Maximum Balanced XOR Subarray Length

examples.explanation: The subarray [1, 3, 2, 0] has bitwise XOR 1 XOR 3 XOR 2 XOR 0 = 0 and contains 2 even and 2 odd numbers.
The whole array has bitwise XOR 0 and contains 4 even and 4 odd numbers.
No non-empty subarray satisfies both conditions.
